findings.detail: GBP local principal was treated as a fair value currency even though the source provides adjacent USD amounts for the position.
EUR local principal was treated as a fair value currency even though the source provides adjacent USD amounts for the position.
CAD appears to be inferred from the issuer text Cascade in a standard USD fair value schedule row, not from a Canadian-dollar source cell.

rationale: FX02 is a real data error. The BDC fair value field should be USD-denominated. The raw source shows local currency columns separately from USD columns for GBP/EUR rows, so storing fair_value_currency as U_GBP or U_EUR reflects extraction from the wrong unit context. For the U_CAD warning, source search found no Canadian-dollar row; the relevant raw schedule row is Cascade Parent Inc. under the standard Cost/Fair Value columns, indicating the CAD unit is an extraction artifact from issuer text rather than source currency.
